action: Give the standalone workspace_application_runtime Fabric operation its own direct provider mutation binding so the application runtime can attach the gateway network, and report an unattached gateway as a distinct not-bound state instead of a hard readback mismatch
necessity: The Control Plane dispatches create_workspace_application_runtime as a standalone idempotent Fabric operation, not as a Workspace launch stage, so withProviderOperationJournal gave it no journal. The gateway-network mutation then failed closed with local_docker_runtime_gateway_mutation_binding_required, and a replay only converged from a failed record, so the gateway container was never attached to the workspace network. In parallel, verifyRuntimeGatewayNetwork collapsed an unattached gateway into local_docker_runtime_gateway_network_readback_mismatch, which the application runtime read returned as a hard failure rather than the still-advanceable not-ready state. Without this fix the first real Local-Docker Agent deployment cannot complete its gateway network binding, which blocks the Serve first-deployment lane that consumes it.

checks: The application runtime operation receives a direct provider mutation binding only for caller control-plane, action create_workspace_application_runtime and resource kind workspace_application_runtime with every binding value present and trimmed
Other caller, other action, other resource kind, missing idempotency key, untrimmed request hash and missing workspace are each refused a direct binding
The derived binding satisfies validWorkspaceLaunchStageBinding and carries the operation's own operation id and idempotency key
The existing provider mutation envelope round trip still fails closed on digest drift, field drift and unknown fields
The whole services/fabric/internal/fabric package passes database-free

remainingBoundary: Source-only verification with the existing Local-Docker provider stubs and database-free tests. No Local-Docker host run, no real gateway container attach replay on a live host, no provider procurement, production access, publication or deployment was performed; live Local qualification remains the separate lane.
